WITH rates AS (
  SELECT
    si.healtheval,
    s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0) AS rate,
    s.scancount AS scan_count
  FROM scans AS s
  INNER JOIN sites AS si
    ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry
  WHERE s.gbsize IS NOT NULL
    AND s.spanmin IS NOT NULL
    AND s.spanmin <> 0
), status_averages AS (
  SELECT
    healtheval,
    AVG(rate) AS avg_rate,
    AVG(scan_count) AS avg_count
  FROM rates
  GROUP BY healtheval
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS all_status_avg_rate
  FROM status_averages
), qualifying_statuses AS (
  SELECT sa.avg_rate, sa.avg_count, oa.all_status_avg_rate
  FROM status_averages AS sa
  CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
  WHERE sa.avg_rate > oa.all_status_avg_rate
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_rate) AS average_rate,
  AVG(avg_count) AS average_count,
  AVG(avg_rate - all_status_avg_rate) AS average_excess_rate
FROM qualifying_statuses;
